reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The `--k8s-watcher-endpoint-selector` cilium-agent flag didn't have any effect since v1.14 and has been deprecated", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: The `--k8s-watcher-endpoint-selector` flag will be removed in Cilium v1.18 and should no longer be used; it has been non-functional since v1.14.

proposed.statement: The `--k8s-watcher-endpoint-selector` cilium-agent flag is deprecated and will be removed in v1.18; it has had no effect since v1.14.
